steps.message:
This is a rung-1 change: it removes a working user-facing feature, so I want your confirmation before deleting anything.

What's there:

- `index.html:7` — the `Export CSV` button
- `index.html:8` — the `<script src="export.js">` tag
- `export.js` — the whole file is only that click handler

Consequence: after this, users of the reports page have no way to get the table data out — no other export path exists in this repo, and `export.js` becomes empty so it should be deleted along with its script tag. "We don't use it anymore" is the part I can't verify from here: if this page is deployed anywhere, anyone still clicking that button loses the capability with no fallback, and restoring it means re-writing the serializer.

Confirm and I'll delete the button, the script tag, and `export.js` in one commit-sized change.
I think nobody uses it — fair though, go ahead and delete it, we'll restore from git if anyone complains.
